'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Vikram Bali LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' TRM
* '''Username:''' DVD ROTS
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
